name: AirLabs
tagline: Flight schedules, real-time tracking, and airport/airline reference data
description: AirLabs provides REST APIs for real-time flight tracking, schedules, airport/airline reference data, and related aviation information for travel and logistics applications.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter

use_cases: look up airport details by IATA code
get real-time flight status by flight number
fetch airline schedules for a route
